name: harness-model-source
title: Harness model source selector (Bedrock Mantle / Bedrock)
description: Add a Model source selector to the Managed Harness create form: Bedrock Mantle (Responses/Chat Completions API) with openai.gpt-5.6-sol|terra|luna, or Bedrock (Converse API) with global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5|claude-opus-5|global.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0. Plumb a new AgentSpec.model_source field into HarnessModelConfiguration.bedrockModelConfig.apiFormat.
